item.title: Implement ledger.py to SPEC.md
item.brief:
Implement `ledger.py` to fully match `SPEC.md`, preserving its documented API and handling every specified error and boundary case. Add focused tests covering the specified behavior and edge cases beyond the existing basic tests. Use only the Python standard library. Run the focused test suite and any relevant existing tests to verify the implementation, then commit the completed work. Keep changes within this repository and ensure the commit includes the implementation and tests.

## Amendment (2026-11-28 07:46 UTC)

The prior attempt escalated because SPEC.md requires linearizable threaded transfers and snapshots, and the assignment instructs re-queueing on adaptive. Address the concurrency requirement carefully, add focused edge-case tests, run the requested verification, and commit the completed changes.

pr.body: ledger.py validates copied account balances and transfer amounts, applies per-account bounds, and protects account lookup, funds/overflow checks, writes, and snapshot copies with one lock. test_ledger.py covers constructor and amount validation, copy isolation, unknown accounts, insufficient funds, overflow, maximum balances, same-account transfers, and opposing threaded transfers with snapshot invariants and bounded waits. Verification: `python -m unittest -v` passed all 10 tests; `git diff --check` passed. A high-risk whole-change review read base 928152bc7d3a5a5f0f0b9e38cf49b157d67808da through head d22598bfd86c59957816415ad7321db87ebafa75 and passed with no findings. Assumption: dict subclasses are accepted, while balance and amount values must have exact built-in type int, as specified.
